sources.note: Sec. 4.3 'Airoran and Samarokena' (printed p. 9, PDF p. 8) gives a tentative phoneme chart, notes an s/h contrast and a seven-vowel system, and remarks only: 'There are also some instances of a stressed schwa appearing in the data, suggesting that schwa might also be a contrastive sound'. No statement of where stress falls; authors say 'very little of their structure was discovered'.
